title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)
summary: Move from another engineering discipline into customer-facing technical delivery: discovery, data, integrations, AI, production, adoption, case studies, a portfolio capstone and interview rehearsal.
audience: Backend, frontend, mobile, data, ML, platform, QA, embedded and solutions engineers transitioning into FDE roles.

units.title: Forward Deployed Engineering: Role And Transition
units.summary: Map your existing engineering strengths to customer discovery, technical delivery, adoption and ownership.

units.title: Customer Discovery And Domain Modeling
units.summary: Turn a vague customer request into a verified workflow, stakeholder map, domain model and delivery brief.

units.title: Value, Scope And Pilot Decisions
units.summary: Choose a measurable pilot, calculate an honest value hypothesis and negotiate explicit delivery boundaries.

units.title: Data Investigation And SQL For FDEs
units.summary: Profile unfamiliar customer data, preserve row meaning, join safely and explain missing or stale evidence.

units.title: Reliable Integrations And Customer Workflows
units.summary: Design API connectors and durable work around scoped identity, uncertain outcomes, retries and reconciliation.

units.title: Security, Permissions And Customer Trust
units.summary: Protect customer data through explicit identity, object authorization, tenant isolation and controlled operational access.

units.title: Applied AI, Retrieval And Bounded Actions
units.summary: Choose where AI helps, build evidence-linked retrieval and constrain model actions with deterministic application policy.

units.title: Evaluation And Experimental Decisions
units.summary: Create representative test sets, isolate failure modes and decide whether an AI or workflow change deserves rollout.

units.title: From Prototype To Production
units.summary: Convert a useful vertical slice into an observable, recoverable deployment with explicit acceptance and operational ownership.

units.title: Operations, Debugging And Incident Leadership
units.summary: Diagnose customer-facing failures through user signals, safe mitigation, structured communication and verified recovery.

units.title: Adoption, Enablement And Sustainable Handover
units.summary: Measure useful behavior, train operators and transfer a deployed workflow without creating permanent dependence on its builder.

units.title: Customer Communication And Product Feedback
units.summary: Lead technical decisions through concise updates, credible demos, scope negotiation and actionable field feedback.

units.title: FDE Case Studies: Outcomes And Evidence
units.summary: Analyze three published customer stories and two fictional failure cases without confusing reported outcomes with transferable proof.

units.title: FDE Portfolio Capstone: Northstar Support Operations
units.summary: Deliver an original customer-workflow project with synthetic data, secure integration, evaluation, operational evidence and a credible handover.

units.title: FDE Interview Practice And Timed Mock
units.summary: Rehearse discovery, decomposition, coding, architecture, customer communication and factual ownership stories with explicit scoring.

units.title: Career Launch, First 90 Days And Field Habits
units.summary: Turn learning evidence into a truthful application, choose role fit and establish effective delivery habits in a new FDE role.
